t: Packages a language model into one file that runs on your computer.
steps: Find the llamafile project page and choose a model file.
Ask IT to approve the download on a test computer.
On macOS or Linux, run chmod +x on the file.
On Windows, add the .exe extension to the file name.
Run the file and open the local address in a browser.
Go offline and test a short chat.
Try whisperfile with a short audio clip.
